item.title: A Tale of Two Engineer-Artisans
item.description: I recently met two interesting individuals. The context in which I met each of them were remarkably similar: each was running a small business selling a specialized boutique commodity. The first was a man operating a small vineyard and winery on the property of his exurban home. The second was a man running a coffee roasting operation out of a small warehouse in an industrial park.
